title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
abstract: arXiv:2611.24877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. translated_title: 仅通过查询利用大语言模型审计黑箱临床预测模型：一项植入缺陷的盲测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.24877v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）被用于解释临床预测模型，其承诺在于能够说明模型计算了什么、发现其缺陷，甚至揭示其中蕴含的新知识。我们在答案可被检验的范围内对这三项承诺进行了测试。基于国际卒中试验中较早随机分组的患者，我们针对两种结局训练了四类模型（逻辑回归、可解释提升机、梯度提升树、神经网络），在24个模型副本中各植入一个缺陷（一个被低估预测的亚组、一个反向的风险因素或一个不合理的阶跃），并将其与8个无缺陷的干净模型混合。GPT-6 Astra 通过一个仅返回模型预测结果的工具，在盲法条件下对每个模型进行了三次审计；评判规则在任何运行之前即已预先确定，并由程序执行。其代理模型（中位数含128个项）以平均 R² 为 0.976 复现了被审计模型的对数几率（128项的加性代理模型为 0.959）……
tldr: 该论文在盲测条件下证明，大语言模型可以仅通过查询黑箱临床预测模型来构建高保真代理模型并检出人为植入的缺陷（如反向风险因素、被低估的亚组和不合理阶跃）。
en_tdlr: This paper shows in a blinded test that an LLM can audit black-box clinical prediction models through queries alone, reconstructing their behavior with high-fidelity surrogates and detecting planted flaws such as reversed risk factors, under-predicted subgroups, and implausible steps.
